settings.name: logistics_experiment_1
settings.description: Experiment to see what the FNB ETC logistics platform state machine looks like, in the format of a standard More Machine state transducer.

events.name: EVENT_001_DELIVERED_CLIENT
events.description: The client has received their bank card.

events.name: EVENT_002_CHECKED_IN_HUB
events.description: The bank card has been checked into the delivery HUB.

events.name: EVENT_004_APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULED
events.description: An appointment has been scheduled for the delivery or collection of the bank card.

events.name: EVENT_006_DELIVERY_FAILED
events.description: Attempted delivery of the bank card was unsuccessful.

events.name: EVENT_014_SCAN_INTO_COURIER_HUB
events.description: The bank card has been scanned into the courier's HUB.

events.name: EVENT_015_AWAITING_DELIVERY_INSTRUCTION_REQUEST_CONTACT_INFO
events.description: The system is awaiting further instructions for delivery and needs the contact information of the receiver.

events.name: EVENT_016_DELIVERED_BRANCH
events.description: The bank card has been delivered to a branch.

events.name: EVENT_022_CHECKED_OUT_SELBY
events.description: The item has been checked out at Selby.

events.name: EVENT_025_COURIER_SCAN_IN_AND_DESTROY
events.description: The courier has scanned in the item and is awaiting instructions to destroy it.

events.name: EVENT_026_DESTROYED
events.description: The item has been destroyed - usually followed by Courier scan in and destroy.

events.name: EVENT_032_CHECKED_IN_DHUB
events.description: Item has been checked into the DHUB.

events.name: EVENT_033_CONTACT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED
events.description: The limit for attempting to contact the receiver has been exceeded.

events.name: EVENT_035_DELIVERED_COMPANY
events.description: The bank card has been delivered to a company.

events.name: EVENT_042_CHECKED_OUT_MHUB
events.description: The bank card has been checked out from MHUB.

events.name: EVENT_043_CHECKED_OUT_DHUB
events.description: The bank card has been checked out from DHUB.

events.name: EVENT_049_DELIVERED_3RD_PARTY
events.description: The bank card has been delivered to a third-party location.

events.name: EVENT_050_DELIVERED_KNOCKNDROP
events.description: The bank card has been delivered via the knockndrop delivery method.

events.name: EVENT_051_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_SUCCESSFUL_TEL
events.description: Successful telephone communication with the customer was established.

events.name: EVENT_052_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_UNSUCCESSFUL_TEL
events.description: Failed to establish telephone communication with the customer.

events.name: EVENT_060_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_UNSUCCESSFUL_TEL_ATTEMPT1
events.description: First telephone communication attempt with the customer was unsuccessful.

events.name: EVENT_061_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_UNSUCCESSFUL_TEL_ATTEMPT2
events.description: Second telephone communication attempt with the customer has failed.

events.name: EVENT_062_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_UNSUCCESSFUL_TEL_ATTEMPT3
events.description: Failed to establish contact with the customer on the third telephone communication attempt.

events.name: EVENT_063_AWAITING_FNB_NUMBER_INVALID
events.description: The system is waiting for an update. The current FNB number associated with the delivery is invalid.

events.name: EVENT_064_AWAITING_FNB_NUMBER_INCORRECT
events.description: The system is on hold. The FNB number on file is incorrect.

events.name: EVENT_065_AWAITING_FNB_CONTACT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED
events.description: The system is waiting for instructions as attempts to contact FNB were unsuccessful.

events.name: EVENT_066_AWAITING_FNB_CANCEL_CARD
events.description: System is on hold until confirmation is received for FNB card cancellation.

events.name: EVENT_067_AWAITING_FNB_REFUSED_SECURITY_CHECK
events.description: The system is waiting for updates as the FNB refused the security check.

events.name: EVENT_068_AWAITING_FNB_COMPANY_REPRESENTATIVE_UNAVAILABLE
events.description: The company rep from FNB is unavailable and the system is waiting.

events.name: EVENT_069_AWAITING_FNB_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED
events.description: The attempts to deliver the FNB item have exceeded and it's on hold.

events.name: EVENT_070_AWAITING_FNB_COMPANY_ADDRESS_INVALID
events.description: FNB's company address is invalid and the system needs an update.

events.name: EVENT_071_AWAITING_FNB_DN_KYC_DOCUMENTS
events.description: Awaiting on FNB to down validate KYC documents.

events.name: EVENT_072_AWAITING_FNB_NO_AUTHORISED_RECIPIENT
events.description: There is no authorized recipient at FNB and the system is waiting.

events.name: EVENT_073_AWAITING_FNB_CLIENT_UNAVALIABLE
events.description: The client from FNB is unavailable and the system is on hold.

events.name: EVENT_074_AWAITING_FNB_NEW_CONTACT_INFO
events.description: The system is waiting for new contact info from FNB.

events.name: EVENT_082_DELIVERY_FAILED_CUSTOMER_MISSED_APPOINTMENT
events.description: The delivery failed because the customer missed the appointment.

events.name: EVENT_083_DELIVERY_FAILED_COURIER_MISSED_APPOINTMENT
events.description: The delivery attempt failed because the courier missed the appointment.

events.name: EVENT_088_AWAITING_FNB_REFUSED_SECURITY_CHECK
events.description: FNB has rejected the security check for this package.

events.name: EVENT_092_AWAITING_FNB_NUMBER_INCORRECT
events.description: The system is waiting. The associated FNB number is incorrect.

events.name: EVENT_092_NO_ID_DOCUMENT_NO_KYC_ID_COCUMENT
events.description: There is neither an ID document nor a KYC ID document available.

events.name: EVENT_099_AWAITING_FEEDBACK_SUPPLIER
events.description: The system is waiting for feedback from the supplier.

events.name: EVENT_108_DAY_BEFORE_DELIVERY
events.description: This milestone is for the day before the planned delivery.

events.name: EVENT_109_ON_THE_DAY_OF_DELIVERY
events.description: This milestone marks the day of actual delivery.

events.name: EVENT_ETC_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_REGULAR
events.description: The "IDENTIFY_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_TYPE" action identifies the type of transport request received, and raises the apropriate internal milestone, either "CARD_ETC_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_REGULAR" or "CARD_ETC_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_RENEWAL".

events.name: EVENT_ETC_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_RENEWAL
events.description: The "IDENTIFY_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_TYPE" action identifies the type of transport request received, and raises the apropriate internal milestone, either "CARD_ETC_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_REGULAR" or "CARD_ETC_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_RENEWAL".

events.name: EVENT_ETC_DAILY_DELIVERY_RECEIVED
events.description: A daily delivery has been received by the ETC system.

events.name: EVENT_ETC_RENEWAL_DELIVERY_RECEIVED
events.description: A renewal delivery was received by the ETC system.

events.name: EVENT_ETC_CUSTOMER_DID_NOT_SETUP_DELIVERY
events.description: The customer did not setup a delivery yet.

events.name: EVENT_ETC_CUSTOMER_SETUP_DELIVERY
events.description: The customer has setup a delivery.

states.name: STATE_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED
states.description: A transport request has been received, either via GTR, or legacy t-pipe.

states.name: STATE_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_REGULAR
states.description: An action triggered when entering the "CARD_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED" raises an internal milestone to transition to a regular or renewal specific delivery request received states.

states.name: STATE_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED_RENEWAL
states.description: An action triggered when entering the "CARD_TRANSPORT_REQUEST_RECEIVED" raises an internal milestone to transition to a regular or renewal specific delivery request received states.

states.name: STATE_CUSTOMER_HAS_SETUP_DELIVERY
states.description: The customer has set up their delivery.

states.name: STATE_CUSTOMER_HAS_NOT_SETUP_DELIVERY
states.description: The customer has not yet set up their delivery.

states.name: STATE_DELIVERY_SETUP
states.description: The customer can set up their delivery.

states.name: STATE_ORDER_COLLECTED_FROM_MANUFACTURER_DAILY
states.description: A daily order has been collected from the manufacturer.

states.name: STATE_ORDER_COLLECTED_FROM_MANUFACTURER_RENEWAL
states.description: A product renewal has been collected from the manufacturer.

states.name: STATE_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_FAILED_ATTEMPT_1
states.description: Attempt to contact a customer to arrange delivery or collection, has failed for the 1st time.

states.name: STATE_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_FAILED_ATTEMPT_2
states.description: Attempt to contact a customer to arrange delivery or collection, has failed for the 2nd time.

states.name: STATE_DAY_BEFORE_DELIVERY
states.description: It is they day before delivery or collection is scheduled to occur.

states.name: STATE_DAY_OF_DELIVERY
states.description: It is they day that delivery or collection is scheduled to occur.

states.name: STATE_DELIVERED
states.description: A card has been successfully delivered.

states.name: STATE_MISSED_APPOINTMENT_CUSTOMER
states.description: The customer missed a delivery or collection appointment.

states.name: STATE_MISSED_APPOINTMENT_COURIER
states.description: The courier missed a delivery or collection appointment.

actions.name: ACTION_SYSTEM_SEND_COURIER_FILE
actions.description: The ETC system generates and sends a courier instruction (courier file) to the courier.

actions.name: ACTION_API_SCHEDULE_DELIVERY
actions.description: Call the courier's shceulde delivery API.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_ORDER_PLACED
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS (depending on whether the customer is on platform or not), to notify them that their order has been placed.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_ORDER_COLLECTED_BY_COURIER
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to the customer, to notify them that their order has been collected by a courier.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_SETUP_DELIVERY_NOW
actions.description: Send a push notification with a setup delivery now link in it, so that the customer can choose to go seup their delivery.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_ORDER_SCHEDULED
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to the customer, to notify them that their delivery has been scheduled.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_DAY_BEFORE_DELIVERY
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to the customer, to notify them that their delivery is scheduled for tomorrow.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_DAY_OF_DELIVERY
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to the customer, to notify them that their delivery is cheduled for today.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_ORDER_DELIVERED
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to the customer, to notify them that their order has been fulfilled.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_DELIVERY_UNSUCCESSFUL
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to the customer, to notify them that their order could not be fulfilled.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_FAILED_1
actions.description: The first attempt to contact the customer failed.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_CUSTOMER_CONTACT_FAILED_2
actions.description: The second attempt to contact the customer failed.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_MISSED_APPOINTMENT_CUSTOMER
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to notify the customer that they missed the delivery or collection appointment.

actions.name: ACTION_MESSAGE_MISSED_APPOINTMENT_COURIER
actions.description: Send a push notification or SMS to notify the customer that the courier missed the delivery or collection appointment.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_INITIATE
actions.description: This is the first action used to initiate the tracking screen to SmartWorX.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_ORDER_PLACED
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen, to show the customer that their screen order has been placed.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_ORDER_COLLECTED_BY_COURIER
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen, to show the customer that their screen order has been collected by a courier.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_ORDER_SCHEDULED
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen, to show that an order has been scheduled.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_DAY_BEFORE_DELIVERY
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen, to show the customer that their delivery is scheduled for tomorrow.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_DAY_OF_DELIVERY
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen, to show the customer that their delivery is scheduled for today.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_ORDER_DELIVERED
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen, to show the customer that their appointment has been mised, either by them, or the courier. The last milestone triggering the state that triggers this action, can be used to determine the appointment was missed by the courier or the customer.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_COMPLETE
actions.description: This action is used to close the tracker after a delivery has completed. The same action is used fro both successful delivery and unssucessful delivery.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_UNSUCCESSFUL
actions.description: Update the tracking screen to notify the customer that the delivery was unsuccessful.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_CONTACT_FAILED_1
actions.description: Update the App trcking screen to notify the customer of the first customer contact attempt failure.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_CONTACT_FAILED_2
actions.description: Update the App trcking screen to notify the customer of the second customer contact attempt failure.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_MISSED_APPOINTMENT_CUSTOMER
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen to notify the customer that they missed the delivery or collection appointment.

actions.name: ACTION_TRACKING_SCREEN_MISSED_APPOINTMENT_COURIER
actions.description: Update the App tracking screen to notify the customer that the courier missed the delivery or collection appointment.
